protocol.scope: All 55 opened real pairs, both directions; numerical implementation audit and exploratory adequacy diagnosis, not a new release policy, tuning, or independent causal validation. IID and row-order block tests are nominal and no cross-pair multiplicity guarantee is claimed. Nonrejection is not proof of independence.
protocol.reference_discrepancy_policy: Retain eigensolver score discrepancies and decision changes; independently reproduce saved-residual HSIC for adequacy. A preliminary implementation exposed tie-sensitive scores under evaluation-row reordering; this amendment precedes the complete audit.
